# Introduction

This file documents the preliminary exploration of our dataset, conducted before pre-registration. No exploratory analysis was performed that is not recorded here. Therefore, this file provides important context for further analyses.

# Preparations

Loading library:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Loading data. The master dataset, the DOI-, and the author-level subsets are all created in `02_Data_Cleaning.Rmd`:
```{r}
PLOS_Data_Full  <- readRDS(here("data", "clean-data", "Cleaned_Master_Data.rds"))
doi_data        <- read_csv(here("data", "clean-data", "DOI_Level_Data.csv"))
author_data     <- read_csv(here("data", "clean-data", "Author_Level_Data.csv"))
```
